newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Credireal bid specs to be published soon.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Credireal bid specs to be published soon.

text.p: The government of Brazil's Minas Gerais state is likely to publish the tender documents for the sale of its bank Credireal in coming days, said a spokesman for the state's Finance office.
He could not predict, however, when the auction will take place.
The upcoming bid specifications, containing the auction's date and Credireal's minimum price, will follow today's publication of a list of eight banks prequalified for the sale.

The banks are Credit Commerciale de France's Banco CCF Brasil, BankBoston's Brazil unit Banco de Boston, General Electric's General Electric Capital Corporation, Banco Industrial e Comercial, Banco Noroeste, Companhia de Investimentos Latinoamericana, Tabal Participacoes and Varejo S.A. Administracao e Participacao.
The spokesman said Companhia de Investimentos Latinoamericana represents Banco Pactual, while Tabal Participacoes and Varejo S.A. Administracao e Participacao represent Banco Bozano, Simonsen.
Minas Gerais' Finance Secretariat also said Credireal was on the road to privatization after a 346.3 million real loan to capitalize the bank was finally approved by the Senate early this week.
